recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-17215 unless a future work group decision changes the shared useContext search parameter pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-17215 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request for Questionnaire, raised in and applied for STU3. It asked to change the too-broad context-code/context-type use-context search to a composite search parameter and to add an example showing its use.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git-svn revision 14003, preserved as commit f5ab8cb7788cd39882449a88139335956a51dd86, titled "GF#17215 - fix problem with composite search parameters on MetadataResource." That commit updated the MetadataResource search parameter template so context-type-value and context-type-quantity composites operate on {{name}}.useContext with code plus value components, made Range searchable as quantity, updated generator/display logic for composite search parameters, and added the Questionnaire context-type-value example to source/search.html.
additional_context: The current build source no longer carries the old MetadataResource spreadsheet as the authoritative Questionnaire artifact, but the later build-core rework materialized the same intent into source/questionnaire/bundle-Questionnaire-search-params.xml. source/fhir.ini actively lists Questionnaire as a current resource, and the active Questionnaire search parameter bundle defines context-type-value and context-type-quantity as composite parameters over Questionnaire.useContext. source/search.html still contains the Questionnaire?context-type-value=focus$... example requested by the issue. No current source match for context-code remains, and the linked Zulip thread supports the same type-plus-value composite interpretation. A Confluence reference search found no additional or conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scoped Questionnaire source already has the composite useContext search parameters and the requested example, so editing would be redundant and could risk drifting from the shared metadata-resource search parameter pattern.
